note: Real, verified Luxembourg IT/ESN companies with their RCS number (numéro RCS, format B<digits>), for country-pack identifier non-regression. The live LBR/RCS registry (lbr.lu) has no free structured API (automated access is restricted/paid) and its search front-end is a JS SPA, so these RCS numbers are the canonical EXPECTED identifiers — the LU pack is 'beta'/degraded (no online resolution wired). Numbers verified 2026-07-16 via northdata.com company pages, which cite the RCS register (RCS B<number>). The parser/helpers are exercised on these canonical forms; format-only, no live lookup.
